comment: Where product and catalog media files are stored — the file system or the database.
modal: Selects the backend for media files: **File System** (the default) or **Database (Deprecated)**. Choose Database only for legacy multi-server setups that relied on it; File System is recommended for new stores.

comment: Which configured database connection media files are stored in.
modal: Picks the database resource (from the connections defined in the deployment config) used to hold media files. Applies only when **Media Storage** is set to Database.
